_comment: Golden fixture (#1804): the sorted set of `env` keys `nightgauge opencode config --json` prints for the reference machine config (openCodeVerbMachineConfig, lmstudio/qwen/qwen3.8-27b) and a bare `--stage feature-dev --worktree <repo> --run-id <id>` invocation. TestOpenCodeConfigVerbEnvKeysMatchGoldenFixture (cmd/nightgauge/opencode_test.go) regenerates this list from the real verb and fails the Go build if it drifts; tests/cli/childEnv.test.ts reads this same file and asserts every key is accepted by the TS allowlist (isOpenCodeRunEnvAccepted), so a variable InstallNightgaugePlugin or OpenCodeIsolationEnv starts setting cannot silently ship without the TS side admitting it. The operator-install-risk flag is never an env key: since #1802 it reaches the manager through RunRoot.OperatorInstallRisk, so the verb never prints it.
